buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.desc: Clear verbs, one primary action per decision.
buttons.snippet:
<button class="nq-button">Start a conversation</button>
<button class="nq-button secondary">Save</button>
<button class="nq-button brand">Try Nasaq</button>
<button class="nq-button" disabled>Unavailable</button>
buttons.rule: Use native disabled for unavailable actions. Tie loading to actual work, keep the label meaningful, and prevent duplicate submission.
props: Small is for dense secondary actions; keep primary touch targets ≥44px.
default / hover / focus / pressed / loading / disabled
Use native disabled; loading follows actual work.

inputs.name: Inputs
inputs.desc: Persistent labels, concise help and actionable validation.
inputs.html:
Example address. Nothing will be sent.
Enter a clear project name.
inputs.snippet: Project contact address.
inputs.rule: Keep labels visible. Associate help/error messages with aria-describedby. Validate at a useful moment and preserve input after errors.
props: Choose the input type for the data, not its appearance.
empty / filled / focus / invalid / readonly / disabled
Readonly remains selectable; disabled is unavailable.

select.name: Select
select.desc: One choice from a compact list of named options.
select.html: Current assistant: Writing assistant
select.rule: Prefer native select for simple choices. Use a visible label and an empty prompt when no selection is required by default.
props: Use for a compact list of mutually exclusive choices.
Use an empty prompt when a deliberate choice is required.

states.name: Invalid
states.html: <select class="nq-select" aria-label="Assistant — invalid" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="state-select-error"><option>Choose an assistant</option></select><small id="state-select-error" class="nq-error-text">Choose an assistant.</small>

checkbox.name: Checkbox
checkbox.desc: Independent choices and explicit mixed selection.
checkbox.html: <fieldset style="border:0;padding:0"><legend>Research sources</legend><label class="nq-check"><input type="checkbox" checked> Attached documents</label><label class="nq-check"><input type="checkbox"> Team library</label><label class="nq-check"><input type="checkbox" disabled> Archive — unavailable</label></fieldset>
checkbox.snippet:
<fieldset>
 <legend>Research sources</legend>
 <label class="nq-check"><input type="checkbox" checked> Documents</label>
 <label class="nq-check"><input type="checkbox"> Team library</label>
</fieldset>
checkbox.rule: Use a native checkbox. Set its indeterminate property for mixed state; give every choice a stable label.
props: Keep the label in the click target.

switch.name: Switch
switch.html: <label class="nq-check"><input class="nq-switch" type="checkbox" role="switch" checked> Save conversation history</label><label class="nq-check"><input class="nq-switch" type="checkbox" role="switch"> Usage notifications</label><label class="nq-check"><input class="nq-switch" type="checkbox" role="switch" disabled> Team sync — unavailable</label>
switch.snippet:
<label class="nq-check">
 <input class="nq-switch" type="checkbox" role="switch" checked>
 Save conversation history
</label>
switch.rule: Use a native checkbox with role="switch" and a stable label. Test click, Space, on/off, disabled, RTL and LTR; keep the label target at least 44px.
props: The label provides a ≥44px touch target.
The label names the setting and does not change with state.
Use role=switch on a native checkbox.

states.name: On
states.html: <label class="nq-check"><input class="nq-switch" role="switch" type="checkbox" checked> Saving</label>

states.html: <label class="nq-check"><input class="nq-switch state-focus" role="switch" type="checkbox" checked> Saving</label>

states.name: Disabled / on
states.html: <label class="nq-check"><input class="nq-switch" role="switch" type="checkbox" checked disabled> Saving</label>

states.name: LTR
states.html: <label class="nq-check" dir="ltr"><input class="nq-switch" role="switch" type="checkbox" checked> Save history</label>

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.desc: Related content panels within one context.
tabs.html:
Every project idea in one place.

No documents yet. Add your first file.

Set the project name and conversation retention preferences.
tabs.snippet:
Summary
Files
tabs.rule: Keep role=tablist, tab and tabpanel linked with aria-controls/labelledby. Support arrows, Home and End; account for writing direction.
props: Arrow keys move focus and select the associated panel.
Each tab controls exactly one panel.
Arrow movement follows the reading direction.

badge.name: Badge
badge.desc: A small written status, category or count.
badge.html: ✦ Writing assistant● Available! Connection failedUnder review
badge.snippet: Writing assistant Available Connection failed
badge.rule: Badges communicate status without acting like buttons. Include a written label; do not rely on color alone.
props: Include text; tone alone is insufficient.
A badge is not a button.

avatar.name: Avatar
avatar.desc: A person or assistant with a dependable fallback.
avatar.html:
SAMA✦
Sarah Ahmed
Content team
avatar.snippet: SA ✦
avatar.rule: If the adjacent name repeats the identity, mark the avatar decorative. Provide an accessible label when the image carries meaning.
props: Use a meaningful fallback when an image fails.
Keep dimensions stable while content loads.

dialog.name: Dialog
dialog.desc: A focused decision with a clear way out.
dialog.snippet:
New conversation?

The previous conversation will stay in history.
dialog.rule: Use native dialog.showModal(). Preserve a labelled heading, Escape dismissal, focus containment and focus return. Destructive decisions need clear consequences.
props: Open with showModal; close with close.

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.desc: Supplementary help on hover and keyboard focus.
tooltip.html: Copy text to clipboard
tooltip.snippet: Copy text to clipboard
tooltip.rule: Keep essential instructions in visible text. Link with aria-describedby, reveal on focus and hover, and allow Escape to dismiss.
props: The tooltip supplements the control’s existing name.
Never make content exclusive to pointer hover.
Do not place interactive controls inside.

radio.name: Radio
radio.desc: Exactly one choice from mutually exclusive alternatives.
radio.html: <fieldset class="nq-radio-group"><legend>Assistant style</legend><label class="nq-check"><input type="radio" name="assistant-tone" checked> Direct</label><label class="nq-check"><input type="radio" name="assistant-tone"> Detailed</label><label class="nq-check"><input type="radio" name="assistant-tone" disabled> Custom — unavailable</label></fieldset>
radio.snippet:
<fieldset class="nq-radio-group">
 <legend>Assistant style</legend>
 <label class="nq-check"><input type="radio" name="tone" value="direct" checked> Direct</label>
 <label class="nq-check"><input type="radio" name="tone" value="detailed"> Detailed</label>
</fieldset>
radio.rule: Use a fieldset and legend with a shared name. Native arrow keys and Space should select choices. Radios select, rather than execute an action.
props: One required choice among visible alternatives.
Use an explicit default only when justified.

textarea.name: Textarea
textarea.desc: Long instructions with room to grow.
textarea.html: Up to 500 characters. This draft is not sent.
textarea.snippet: Up to 500 characters.
textarea.rule: Allow vertical resizing, explain limits before input, and preserve drafts. Keep a visible label and associated help text.
props: empty / filled / focus / invalid / readonly / disabled
only when a real product limit exists

alert.name: Alert
alert.desc: A useful message that describes what happened and what to do.
alert.html:
Draft saved.

Return to it from the project.

Could not connect.

Your message was kept. Try again.
alert.snippet:
Could not connect.

Your message was kept.
alert.rule: Use a written status and a clear recovery action. Reserve role=alert for urgent updates; avoid announcing static page content repeatedly.
props: Write what happened and what the user can do.
Use alert only for urgent new information.
Keep recovery adjacent to the message.

states.name: Warning
states.html: You are approaching your usage limit.

states.name: Error
states.html: Could not save. Try again.

progress.name: Progress
progress.desc: Real progress with a stated value or an honest indeterminate state.
progress.html: <label for="usage-progress">Quota used — 28%</label><progress id="usage-progress" class="nq-progress" max="100" value="28">28%</progress><label for="upload-progress">Indeterminate progress — uploading</label><progress id="upload-progress" class="nq-progress">Uploading</progress>
progress.snippet:
<label for="usage">Quota used — 28%</label>
<progress id="usage" class="nq-progress" max="100" value="28">28%</progress>
progress.rule: Set value and max only when progress is known. Give the control a label. Omit value for indeterminate work and stop when finished or failed.
props: Use indeterminate when duration is unknown.
State the actual unit of work.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.desc: Temporary geometry while actual content loads.
skeleton.html: Loading project…
skeleton.snippet: Loading project…
skeleton.rule: Keep skeletons decorative, mark the content region aria-busy during work, and expose a textual status. Respect reduced motion and show a recoverable error.
props: Announce a concise written loading status.

states.html: Could not load the project.

accordion.rule: Prefer native details/summary. Keep headings and key decisions visible outside collapsed content. Do not use fabricated disabled states.

props: Use meaningful headings within a collection.

breadcrumb.rule: Use a labelled nav, links for ancestors and aria-current=page for the current location. Wrap rather than truncate essential context.
props: Give the navigation a useful name.

chat.name: Chat
chat.rule: Keep the composer available, preserve drafts and distinguish user messages, AI output and source references. Real products need generating, stop, error and retry states.
chat.html:
✦ Nasaq assistant
Assistant

What would you like to explore?

A fixed local response demonstrates the layout. No AI request is sent.

search.name: Knowledge search
search.rule: Show the query, result count and source context. Keep empty and failed requests distinct; do not invent source confidence.

dashboard.name: Usage dashboard
dashboard.rule: State the period, units and limits. Give visual charts an equivalent written summary. All values in this preview are illustrative.

onboarding.name: Onboarding
onboarding.rule: Explain what will be stored before asking for personal information. Keep the first task short.
onboarding.html:
Your first project

Validates locally; nothing is created or saved.

assistant-picker.name: Assistant picker
assistant-picker.rule: Explain each assistant’s purpose, input and limitations before selection.
assistant-picker.html:
Writing

Shape a first draft.

Research

Organize questions and sources.

Analysis

Read a dataset with context.

sources.name: Sources
sources.rule: Link to actual sources, identify the publisher and let users verify claims. Never manufacture citations.
sources.html:
Design-token format

A source for the structure of tokens used in Nasaq.

Design Tokens Community Group specification ↗

empty.name: Empty state
empty.rule: Describe the absence of content and offer a relevant next step. Keep it distinct from loading and error states.
empty.html:
No documents yet.

Add your first document to organize your project.

generation.name: Generating & stop
generation.rule: Tie status to a real job. Stop must cancel actual work and preserve input. This preview only changes local display state.
generation.html: Illustrative generation is paused.

attachments.name: Attachments
attachments.rule: Explain supported file types and actual size limits before selection. Real uploads need progress, cancellation, removal and error recovery.
attachments.html: Local selection only: no reading, upload or storage.

quota.name: Quota & subscription
quota.rule: Explain the allowance, renewal date and price before blocking work. Show real usage and billing data in production.
quota.html:
28 of 100 requests used28%

Illustrative quota. Your product defines renewal and billing.

Compare example plans

settings.name: Settings & privacy
settings.rule: Group related preferences. State retention duration and deletion behavior; communicate save failures without losing the user’s choice.
settings.html:
Conversation preferences

Local preference example; nothing is stored.

retry.name: Error & retry
retry.rule: Preserve the user’s input, state what failed and offer a useful recovery path. Avoid vague errors or retries that discard content.
retry.html:
Could not connect.

Your message was kept. Try again when you are ready.
